author_or_institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology, Center for AI Standards and Innovation
title: Insights into AI Agent Security from a Large-Scale Red-Teaming Competition
book_use: Documents a 2026 public red-teaming competition covering 13 frontier models, more than 250,000 attack attempts, and over 400 participants; at least one successful hijacking attack was found against every target model, with some attack families transferring across models and scenarios.
